title: Practice 3: под- and от-: up to, and away from

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **подходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of подходить: imperfective (perfective partner: подойти).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).
exercises.prompt: Summer is coming to an end.

exercises.why: **отошёл** — past tense (masculine) of отойти: perfective (imperfective partner: отходить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
**отвезёт** — future tense (3rd person singular) of отвезти: perfective (imperfective partner: отвозить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
**отходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of отходить: imperfective (perfective partner: отойти).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
exercises.prompt: Where does the bus leave from?

exercises.q: I took my cat to the veterinary hospital yesterday.
exercises.why: **отвёз** — past tense (masculine) of отвезти: perfective (imperfective partner: отвозить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
exercises.ru: Я вчера ___ кота в ветеринарную клинику.

exercises.why: **отвези** — imperative (ты, singular) of отвезти: perfective (imperfective partner: отвозить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
**подвезла** — past tense (feminine) of подвезти: perfective (imperfective partner: подвозить).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).
exercises.prompt: I gave her a ride home.

exercises.why: **отведу** — future tense (1st person singular) of отвести: perfective (imperfective partner: отводить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
**подвезти** — infinitive, perfective (imperfective partner: подвозить).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).
exercises.prompt: Do you need a ride to school?

exercises.why: **отвозил** — past tense (masculine) of отвозить: imperfective (perfective partner: отвезти).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
**отвезу** — future tense (1st person singular) of отвезти: perfective (imperfective partner: отвозить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
**отплывает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of отплывать: imperfective (perfective partner: отплыть).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
exercises.prompt: The ship is sailing at three.

exercises.why: **отведите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of отвести: perfective (imperfective partner: отводить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
exercises.prompt: Take these goats to the mountain.

exercises.why: **отнеси** — imperative (ты, singular) of отнести: perfective (imperfective partner: относить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
exercises.prompt: Take the jug to the cellar.

exercises.why: **подбежала** — past tense (feminine) of подбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: подбегать).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).
exercises.prompt: The dog came running to us.

exercises.why: **отвёл** — past tense (masculine) of отвести: perfective (imperfective partner: отводить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
exercises.prompt: I took the children to school.

exercises.why: **отведи** — imperative (ты, singular) of отвести: perfective (imperfective partner: отводить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
exercises.prompt: Take these goats to the mountain.

exercises.why: **отойдите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of отойти: perfective (imperfective partner: отходить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
exercises.prompt: Stand clear of the edge of the platform.

exercises.why: **отводит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of отводить: imperfective (perfective partner: отвести).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
exercises.prompt: He walks the children to school.

exercises.why: **отвозит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of отвозить: imperfective (perfective partner: отвезти).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
